caption: The drawing depicts a square textile or fabric sample with a decorative design. The composition includes a pattern of diagonal blue lines covering most of the area, resembling quilting or stitching. There are two large curved green bands, edged with a zigzag pattern, forming a quarter circle in one corner. At the center of the square, there is a branch depicted in green with three ovate pink leaves outlined in darker pink, each with a yellow, leaf-shaped interior design. Four smaller pink oval shapes with yellow tips are positioned at equal distances near the edges, suggesting additional decorative elements. The whole design is bordered by a double outline in pink. The overall color palette consists of blue, green, pink, and yellow on a plain off-white background.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
